title: Sharp First-Hit Identification from Finite Depth Samples
abstract: arXiv:2611.19563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Which depths in a new camera view are determined by finitely many source-depth measurements? Pointwise uncertainty bounds do not answer this question: unobserved geometry between samples can change which surface is encountered first. We study a bounded Lipschitz class of continuous source inverse-depth fields with interval observations and known camera pose. Building on classical Lipschitz envelopes, we characterize the exact set of attainable first-hit depths and construct a globally admissible scene for every value in that set. The set can be disconnected. We also give a necessary and sufficient test for several proposed depths to be first hits of one shared scene. An epipolar reduction uses scalar cone inequalities without enumerating surfaces. translated_title: 从有限深度样本中精确识别首次命中深度
translated_abstract: 在一个新的相机视角中，哪些深度是由有限多个源深度测量所确定的？逐点的不确定性界无法回答这个问题：样本之间未被观测到的几何结构可能改变最先遇到的表面是哪一个。我们研究了一类有界Lipschitz连续的源逆深度场，其观测为区间形式且相机位姿已知。在经典Lipschitz包络的基础上，我们刻画了可实现的首次命中深度的精确集合，并为该集合中的每一个值构造了一个全局可行的场景。该集合可以是不连通的。我们还给出了判定若干给定深度能否同时作为同一共享场景的首次命中的充要条件检验。一种对极归化方法利用标量锥不等式，无需枚举表面。在一个源间距为 $h$、区间半宽为 $\varepsilon$、基线为 $b$、斜率界为 $L$ 的校正模型中，我们证明了最坏情况下逆深度直径的紧确界为 $\max\{Lh+2\varepsilon,\ldots\}$（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文在区间观测与已知相机位姿下，对有界Lipschitz逆深度场精确刻画了由有限深度采样所能确定的首次命中深度集合（并证明该集合可能不连通），给出了多个深度同属单一场景的充要判定方法，并在校正模型中证明了紧确的最坏情况逆深度直径界。
en_tdlr: This paper exactly characterizes the set of first-hit depths attainable from finitely many depth samples of a bounded Lipschitz inverse-depth field—showing the set can be disconnected—derives a necessary-and-sufficient consistency test via scalar cone inequalities without surface enumeration, and proves a sharp worst-case inverse-depth diameter bound in a rectified model.
